Our mission is to strengthen resiliency in people and their communities through prevention, education, and services that improve the quality of life.
Supporting families affected by substance use disorder and mental health through treatment planning, community linkage, and educational awareness.
Life Learning Center delivers a holistic, integrated continuum of education and care to help our 'at-risk' citizens step up to their highest potential.

Mariners Inn serves as an anchor for those struggling to navigate the treacherous waters of homelessness and substance abuse through a wide range of social service programs and recovery support services that achieve the best possible outcome for adults, families and youth affected by addiction.
Our mission is to uplift the lives of people in recovery from substance use and mental disorders and create a positive impact for their families, and their communities.

Our mission is to create an affordable network of safe, clean and structured living environments for men and women with the goal of recovery from alcohol and/or drug addiction. Through compassion and empathy, we provide residents with the support needed to create a unique treatment plan and living environment conductive to growth, support, and accountability, allowing residents to the freedom to grow, recover, thrive, help others, and re-enter into society.
A Safe Supportive Environment, Recovery Support Services and Education for Mental Health and Substance Use Disorders to Build Purpose, Mental Wellness and a Community of Recovery.
To empower people to rise and thrive beyond their circumstances. Every day we serve those in challenging situations using a "WHOLE-istic" approach.

We envision a nation where individualized support in recovery from Substance Use Disorder is an accessible option, to anyone, anywhere
Our mission is to help and encourage individuals who are struggling with mental illness, addiction and trauma by offering peer support services with a holistic approach.

column2: Community Awareness Resource Entity of Arizona
column12: The mission of Community Awareness Resource Entity of Arizona (CAREaz) is to deliver culturally-adapted evidence-based prevention, treatment and recovery services; and engage and mobilize the community to create a safe and healthy environment.
Embrace ND is founded in faith to serve as a bridge to services and agencies within our community. Our mission is to meet you where you are at and walk with you and your family to long term recovery.

Shifting addiction patterns to healthier behavior patterns, helping seek treatments and develop a complete understanding of addressing addiction through community resources! Relating, empowering and showing others that treatment is effective! People CAN and DO RECOVER!

Iowa Recovery Rescue Community exists to serve the recovery community of Iowa by establishing a coalition to gather resources and create partnerships using innovation to expand quality sober housing, offer training/certifications, and create programs for those seeking to utilize peer to peer coaching, strive to establish more support services, host events to thwart the stigma of substance use disorders and provide solutions through every opportunity possible using a peer to peer approach as a recognized recovery community organization.

column2: Innerman Wellness And Support Services LLC
column12: The Mission Of Inner man Wellness And Support Services is to offer tangible resources within the recovery community in hopes of adding value and purpose to persons lives.
To advance peer support in Florida.

To help all who seek to recover from addiction, begin to rebuild, find happiness and rejoin their community in a way that is respectful and allows them to progress in recovery in a judgment-free and safe environment.

Superior Housing Solutions exists to assure that all vulnerable individuals, including those who are homeless and/or near homeless, have access to housing that is safe, affordable, accessible and appropriate to promote self-actualization in an inclusive and supportive community.

The mission of Pure Recovery is to restore human lives from former addicts to functioning, contributing citizens through transitional housing, community re-unification, as well as psychological, behavioral and peer support.

column2: Personal Empowerment Recovery Coalition (PERC) of Arkansas
column12: The Personal Empowerment Recovery Coalition is a state-wide, peer-run organization that exists to: Advocate for the empowerment of persons with lived experience of behavioral health challenges; Promote the transformation of behavioral health care to be compassionate, trauma-informed, person-centered and strength-based; educate policy-makers, behavioral health consumers and the general public in Arkansas to eliminate stigma and demonstrate that recovery is possible.
To transform chemically dependent individuals through loving accountable relationships, family restoration and a Christ centered 12 step residential treatment program.
Heart2HeartLV seeks to provide next step services to individuals and families pursuing long term sustainable recovery from drug and alcohol abuse and its effects.
